items.reason: An unbound set using a linked-worktree runtime override prints “no binding” even though setup records an adopted binding before rendering.
Whole-set command routing always supplies the header, including when invoked inside the bound checkout.
InvokedFrom resolves the project checkout root rather than the actual cwd, omitting or misreporting invocations from subdirectories.
BoundDefault triggers the “binding recorded to current checkout” announcement.
The old conditional “draining at bound checkout” output is removed.
Single-task AFK execution prints the current-checkout line without a Drain header.
The current-checkout line prints before the single-task HITL branch.
Successful task execution prints one green done result through printTaskDone.
Commit SHA or verified-no-op detail prints immediately beneath the done line.
The old Completed line is removed, with one result emitted per execution ending.
Exhausted retries retain the failed transition and emit one red failed result.
Provider exhaustion is classified separately, printing one red left-open result without failing the task.
Quota recovery parking prints the yellow quota-paused result with the selected preset.
Interrupted execution prints the yellow interrupted result before interrupt-gate handling.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level outcomes; executed tasks retain their own result lines.
Attempt narration and exhaustion output remain; successful attempt breakdowns move beneath the result details.
Both renderers use the existing output wrapper, preserving full text without ANSI on redirected output.
Result lines use semantic colors and the existing NO_COLOR-aware terminal handling.
Header and result rendering add no journal writes.

scores.rationale: Clear, focused rendering changes with useful tests, but invocation-path and binding-metadata edge cases remain; validation was static.
